description: This is an XML source file defining simple methods related to manufacturing production run tasks and routing within the OFBiz framework. It contains definitions for editing, adding, and creating production runs, including parameter processing and service calls.

methods.name: editProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Checks parameters, validates and converts data, then calls service to update routing task.

methods.name: addProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Validates parameters and calls service to add a new production run routing task.

methods.name: createProductionRun
methods.description: Determines which production run creation process to invoke based on input parameters.
